name: Kazerne Weesp
description: Weesp’s volunteer fire station moved from the Achtergracht to the Aetsveldselaan in 2011. Its history began in 1888 in a former telegraph and post office with five hand pumps. The present station combines a curved four-bay appliance hall with a timber-faced upper volume and distinctive trapezoidal glazing.
facts: Volunteer crews respond from home or work when their pager sounds.
The station occupied the Achtergracht from 1960 until its move here in 2011.
The original 1888 station used a former telegraph and post office.
